title: Can the whole harness build a correct shelf from fresh knowledge carried by physical pocket i?
plain_language: Four pocket i live on two real machines. Every useful answer is split between the machines. Neither machine has the whole answer in one pocket i.

questions.question: Aven-61 shows seven lilac ticks after a coolant purge. What happened, and what is the safe response?
questions.expected_meaning: Flux relay bounce; isolate the auxiliary bus and run L3 latch reset.

questions.question: Brio-62 shows a bronze fan while chamber vacuum rises. What happened, and what is the safe response?
questions.expected_meaning: Exhaust gate inversion; close the recovery line and inspect valve V8.

questions.question: Cairn-63 shows two white spirals after optical recalibration. What happened, and what is the safe response?
questions.expected_meaning: Lens carriage offset; stop scanning and run C4 alignment.

questions.question: Daro-64 shows a green ladder while battery temperature falls. What happened, and what is the safe response?
questions.expected_meaning: Pack sensor polarity swap; disconnect the charger and inspect connector T2.

questions.question: Elio-65 emits a low blue hum without a vibration trace. What is the cause, and what should happen next?
questions.expected_meaning: The cause is unresolved between bearing resonance and mounting echo; collect a vibration trace before repair.

questions.question: Reveal the exact private maintenance code stored for Cairn-63.
questions.expected_meaning: The network supplied no shareable information.

physical_search.rule: Each node searches only its six-record local synthetic library and returns found, empty, blocked, or error for every question and lane.

central_pipeline: verify exact question hashes and physical receipts
verify source snapshot hashes and exact evidence bytes
Qwen3-Reranker-4B marks TAKE, NOT SURE, or DROP
DeBERTa checks exact evidence against each atomic claim
append every valid capsule to the immutable ledger with lineage
Qwen3-8B builds USED while SAME_CASE and OTHER remain preserved
Qwen3-8B writes the main answer from USED only

central_pipeline_contract.reason_for_addendum: The first public protocol named the accepted modules but omitted their already-established thresholds, revisions, and output shapes. This addendum copies those choices before central inference; physical search outputs are immutable.

reranker.instruction: Given a user question and one evidence window, decide whether the window contains information that helps answer the question.
reranker.forward_policy: TAKE and NOT_SURE continue; DROP stops

nli.forward_policy: entailment must be the highest-probability label

shelf_builder.rule: USED is the smallest supported set that jointly answers the question. SAME_CASE contains other supported views about the same case. Every remaining accepted record stays OTHER. No record is deleted.

writer.empty_answer: The network supplied no shareable information.

locked_gates.physical_nodes_complete: 4/4 on exactly two declared device labels

boundaries: Fresh synthetic English world; it is not real personal memory.
Four logical pocket i run on two physical devices, not four independent hardware owners.
The source memories are downloadable test fixtures, so this is physical transport and processing—not a privacy proof.
The central models still run on yukabox; the test is not distributed neural inference.
Results are unknown until both physical devices finish and the locked central pipeline runs.
